title: Isolate absolute delay-gain ranking with API-compatible single-candidate sizing
hypothesis: Cost-normalized sizing can prefer a smaller timing improvement over a larger eligible delay reduction on violating data paths. Preserve the champion upsizeCell API and single-candidate generation, but select the replacement with maximum positive finite stage delay gain, retaining the preceding-driver input-capacitance penalty and existing eligibility checks. AES critical X1 logic provides the clearest opportunity, while Ibex may benefit within its data cone; its fanout-943 clock gate is not evidence for this mechanism. Iteration 3 never reached timing evaluation, so this retry isolates ranking from candidate multiplicity and avoids its incompatible API rename. Improved selections should reduce matched-endpoint data arrivals and WNS/TNS, subject to upstream loading, hold, area, DRV, and placement gates.

evaluator.lesson: Absolute stage-gain ranking changed rising-edge replacement selection and failed unit gates before any benchmark timing benefit could be measured.
evaluator.dead_end: Repeating the same gate-failing absolute-gain selector without resolving its selection contract cannot produce evaluable timing evidence.
bad_changes: src/rsz/src/move/SizeUpGenerator.cc: replacing cost-normalized ranking with absolute gain conflicts with two existing rising-edge master assertions; timing impact is unmeasured.
